fc4c7559e6.why: The four shifts, two packs, and four averages all contribute to required outputs, with no redundant copy or separate load that can be folded.

6ab3559e60.why: The window shifts and arithmetic feed the stored output or live xmm0, while the separate lddqu load preserves support for unaligned input.

20b41d3f58.why: The window calculations and both rounded averages feed required outputs, while the separate lddqu load preserves support for unaligned input.
